description_en: Updates the global API MCP Server configuration for a user
description_zh: 修改用户全局API MCP Server配置
kebab_example: aliyun openapiexplorer update-api-mcp-server-user-config --enable-public-access true --vpc-whitelists vpc-j6cgd2if5lg000xs6m5se --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateApiMcpServerUserConfig

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable public network access for all API MCP Servers in your account, including the system MCP Server. By default, public network access is enabled. If you disable it, you can only access the servers through their VPC domain names
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启账户下所有API MCP Server（包含系统MCP Server）的公网访问能力，默认为开启，关闭后只能通过VPC域名访问
parameters.name: enable_public_access

parameters.help_en: The VPC whitelist. After disabling public network access, use this parameter to specify allowed source VPCs. If you do not set this parameter or leave it empty, all source VPCs are allowed
parameters.help_zh: 关闭公网访问后，限定来源的VPC白名单，不设置或为空表示不限制来源
parameters.name: vpc_whitelists
